editorial.blurb: A neighborhood institution since 2012 with a recently refreshed look, L'Patron serves up authentic Mexican fare with standout guacamole and hand-crafted margaritas.
editorial.insiderTip: Go during happy hour and bring cash—the combo meals are reasonably priced, though note that all three tacos must be the same meat. Expect a 20-30 minute wait during busy times, but your food arrives hot and perfectly cooked.
